pages.text: The Wireless Crafting Monitor is a portable version of the regular Crafting Monitor that allows you to monitor and manage autocrafting tasks from anywhere within range of a Wireless Transmitter.

To use the Wireless Crafting Monitor:$(li)Right-click while holding it to open the interface$(li)Insert a Network Card to connect to a wireless network$(li)Use it within range of a configured Wireless Transmitter$(li)Monitor and manage autocrafting tasks just like a regular Crafting Monitor

The Wireless Crafting Monitor supports all the same features as a regular Crafting Monitor, including:$(li)Viewing active crafting tasks$(li)Canceling crafting tasks$(li)Viewing task progress$(li)Viewing required and missing items$(li)Starting new crafting tasks
